digest.component_or_area: live-DC readiness / Jira integration test harness
propositions: serverInfo 200 response is insufficient readiness signal; GreenHopper custom fields (Epic Link, Epic Name) may not be registered yet despite serverInfo being green
harness wait_for_jira_dc_ready polls only /rest/api/2/serverInfo and never verifies field inventory, while probe _await_named_fields does; the two paths have diverged readiness definitions

a timing flake where custom fields register slowly after serverInfo goes green causes _assert_project_capabilities to misattribute the missing field to image degrade rather than delayed plugin initialization

harness survives the flake only incidentally because subsequent slow work (dependency install, test collection) delays the field assertion long enough for fields to register; probe catches the real state in the first second

readiness must be gated on presence of every required field name in /rest/api/2/field inventory (never system-only), with bounded budget and self-diagnosing inventory dump on timeout, shared by both harness and probe to prevent drift
